```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Load packages for data cleaning and visualization
library(tidyverse)

# Set default options for R Markdown output
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

## Data Import

```{r import-data}
# Import the original datasets
covar <- read.csv("GSE85307_covar-1.csv")

gene_expr <- read.csv(
  "GSE85307_geneExpression.csv",
  row.names = 1,
  check.names = FALSE
)

gene_names <- read.csv("GSE85307_geneNames.csv")
```

## Initial Data Inspection

```{r inspect-data}
# Check the dimensions of the three datasets
dim(covar)
dim(gene_expr)
dim(gene_names)

# Inspect variable names and sample identifiers
names(covar)
head(colnames(gene_expr))
head(rownames(gene_expr))
names(gene_names)
```

## Sample ID Validation

```{r check-sample-ids}
# Check whether all covariate sample IDs exist in the expression matrix
all(covar$geoID %in% colnames(gene_expr))

# Check whether all expression sample IDs exist in the covariate data
all(colnames(gene_expr) %in% covar$geoID)

# Check for duplicated sample IDs in both datasets
anyDuplicated(covar$geoID)
anyDuplicated(colnames(gene_expr))

# Check whether the sample IDs are in the same order
identical(covar$geoID, colnames(gene_expr))
```

## Sample Alignment

```{r align-samples}
# Identify the positions of covariate sample IDs in the expression matrix
sample_order <- match(covar$geoID, colnames(gene_expr))

# Reorder expression columns to match the covariate sample order
gene_expr_aligned <- gene_expr[, sample_order, drop = FALSE]

# Verify that the sample IDs are correctly aligned
identical(covar$geoID, colnames(gene_expr_aligned))
```

## Covariate Inspection

```{r inspect-covariates}
# Inspect the original covariate data structure
str(covar)

# Check the data types of all covariates
sapply(covar, class)

# Check for missing values in the original data
colSums(is.na(covar))
```

## Data Cleaning

```{r clean-continuous}
# Create a working copy and clean the continuous variables
covar_clean <- covar %>%
  mutate(
    # Remove text prefixes and convert maternal age and BMI to numeric
    mat_age_yrs = as.numeric(str_remove(mat_age_yrs, ".*: ")),
    mat_BMI = as.numeric(str_remove(mat_BMI, ".*: "))
  )
```

## Data Cleaning Validation

```{r validate-cleaning}
# Inspect the data structure after cleaning
glimpse(covar_clean)

# Check for missing values introduced during conversion
sum(is.na(covar_clean$mat_age_yrs))
sum(is.na(covar_clean$mat_BMI))

# Review the distributions of the cleaned variables
summary(covar_clean$mat_age_yrs)
summary(covar_clean$mat_BMI)
```
## Categorical Variable Inspection

```{r inspect-categorical}
# Check the original categories of pregnancy outcome
table(covar_clean$preg_preeclampsia, useNA = "ifany")

# Check the number of observations below and above BMI 25
table(covar_clean$mat_BMI >= 25, useNA = "ifany")
```

## Categorical Variable Cleaning

```{r clean-categorical}
# Clean pregnancy outcome and create BMI categories
covar_clean <- covar_clean %>%
  mutate(
    # Remove the text prefix from pregnancy outcome
    preg_preeclampsia = str_remove(preg_preeclampsia, ".*: "),

    # Convert pregnancy outcome to a categorical variable
    preg_preeclampsia = factor(
      preg_preeclampsia,
      levels = c("Normal", "Preeclampsia")
    ),

    # Categorize maternal BMI using the cutoff of 25 kg/m2
    BMI_group = case_when(
      mat_BMI < 25 ~ "BMI < 25",
      mat_BMI >= 25 ~ "BMI >= 25",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # Set the order of BMI categories
    BMI_group = factor(
      BMI_group,
      levels = c("BMI < 25", "BMI >= 25")
    )
  )
# Check the number of observations in each combination
count(covar_clean, preg_preeclampsia, BMI_group)

# Check for missing values after categorization
colSums(is.na(covar_clean[, c("preg_preeclampsia", "BMI_group")]))

```

## Gene Selection

```{r inspect-gene}
# Inspect the structure of the gene annotation dataset
glimpse(gene_names)

# Find the probe IDs associated with PTX3
gene_names %>%
  filter(GENE == "PTX3")

# Check whether the corresponding probes exist in the expression matrix
gene_names %>%
  filter(GENE == "PTX3") %>%
  mutate(in_expression_data = as.character(PROBEID) %in%
           rownames(gene_expr_aligned))
```

## Analysis Dataset

```{r extract-gene-expression}
# Extract PTX3 expression values from the aligned expression matrix
ptx3_expression <- as.numeric(
  gene_expr_aligned["8083594", ]
)

# Add PTX3 expression to the cleaned covariate dataset
analysis_data <- covar_clean %>%
  mutate(PTX3_expression = ptx3_expression)

# Check the dimensions of the analysis dataset
dim(analysis_data)

# Inspect the selected variables
analysis_data %>%
  select(geoID, mat_age_yrs, mat_BMI,
         preg_preeclampsia, BMI_group, PTX3_expression) %>%
  head()

# Check for missing gene expression values
sum(is.na(analysis_data$PTX3_expression))

# Summarize PTX3 expression levels
summary(analysis_data$PTX3_expression)
```

## Data Visualization

### Figure 1. Distribution of PTX3 Gene Expression

```{r histogram, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
# Plot the distribution of PTX3 gene expression
ggplot(analysis_data, aes(x = PTX3_expression)) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 15,
    fill = "blue",
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of PTX3 Gene Expression",
    x = "PTX3 Expression Level",
    y = "Number of Samples"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)
```

### Figure 2. Maternal Age and PTX3 Expression

```{r scatterplot, fig.width=7, fig.height=5, fig.cap="Figure 2. Relationship between maternal age and PTX3 gene expression."}
# Examine the relationship between maternal age and PTX3 expression
ggplot(analysis_data, aes(x = mat_age_yrs, y = PTX3_expression)) +
  geom_point(
    color = "blue",
    alpha = 0.7,
    size = 2
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    se = TRUE,
    color = "brown",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Maternal Age (years)",
    y = "PTX3 Expression Level"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)
```

### Figure 3. PTX3 Expression by Pregnancy Outcome and BMI Group

```{r boxplot, fig.width=7, fig.height=5, fig.cap="Figure 3. PTX3 gene expression by pregnancy outcome and maternal BMI group."}
# Compare PTX3 expression across pregnancy outcomes and BMI groups
ggplot(
  analysis_data,
  aes(x = preg_preeclampsia, y = PTX3_expression, fill = BMI_group)
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.65,
    alpha = 0.8,
    outlier.shape = 16,
    outlier.size = 1.5
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("BMI < 25" = "blue",
               "BMI >= 25" = "brown")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Pregnancy Outcome",
    y = "PTX3 Expression Level",
    fill = "Maternal BMI"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top"
  )
```
